card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a $12,500 claimer. Four horses want the front, so the early fractions should be honest. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 3 points.

card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a maiden special weight. We make the top one 26% against the board's 23%. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 3 points.
card_reads.shape: No one horse is entitled to the lead going a mile on turf, so expect a tactical early half and a race decided in the lane rather than on the front end. Only one has shown genuine early speed, and without company it may get away with a softer lead than the figures suggest. No pace adjustment applied.
